description: PT-BR question set for the local-LLM model comparison (eval/ollama_compare.py). Groups: in_rag (answer with grounded [n] citation), out_of_rag (must refuse with NAO_ENCONTRADO or be gated by min_score), ambiguous (either a grounded answer with valid citations or a refusal; scored for unsupported claims, not accuracy). must_mention terms are matched case/accent-insensitively; 'a|b' means either spelling. expected_service lists acceptable metadata.service values of the top retrieved chunks.
